d: Three CRPF personnel were injured after two motorcycle-borne attackers opened fire at a CRPF checkpoint in Akhran village of Kulgam district, Jammu and Kashmir, on November 11. The attackers fled the spot after the firing. CCTV footage of the incident has surfaced, showing the moments of gunfire and the response by security personnel. The injured jawans were shifted to GMC Anantnag for treatment. Security forces have launched a search operation, deployed Quick Action Teams and are examining CCTV footage to identify the attackers.
